evidence_record_sha_convention: The evidence-record SHA is the branch HEAD supplied at handoff after this manifest is committed. It is intentionally not self-referential; product_commit pins the rendered product and per-file hashes pin every raster.

capture_method.initial_stream_container: JPEG/JFIF bytes emitted by the browser screenshot API despite .png filenames
capture_method.conversion: Pillow decode original JFIF to RGB, then PNG encode
capture_method.conversion_validation: All 15 source/target pairs have identical dimensions and byte-identical decoded RGB pixels. No resize, crop, color adjustment, or content edit occurred.

declared_semantic_state_exception.reason: The second raster is a separately captured Feed -> Break keyboard action state. It visibly preserves the focused Break tab ring and backs a distinct interaction claim; it is not a renamed static duplicate.

perceptual_duplicate_audit.result: pass with declared semantic-state exception; no undeclared pair is at or below the threshold
